title: Add representative workload runners and reporting pipeline v15
author: Maya Patel
ci_checks: ci/integration-tests: failed on first run (timeout) then passed on rerun
description: Adds a new set of representative workload runners and the reporting pipeline v15 used by Benchmark Lab for production profiling baselines and automated daily reports. Motivation: recent changes to batching and KV cache handling require end-to-end representative workloads to validate throughput/latency regressions across model variants and quantization profiles. This PR introduces: 1) representative runners for chat, streaming generative, and embedding workloads with realistic prompt distributions and dynamic seq lengths; 2) a versioned reporting pipeline (v15) that ingests runner outputs, computes latency/p95/p999, token-cost breakdowns, and stores canonical baselines in the profiling datastore; 3) CI workflow and smoke tests to run a lightweight subset on PRs and nightly full-run schedules; 4) README and upgrade notes for operators. Testing: unit tests for runner harness, end-to-end smoke in CI, manual validation of daily reports on staging for three days. Rollout: feature gated behind benchmark_lab.enable_v15 and rollout started on staging then production once nightly runs are green for 48 hours. Follow-ups: add more workload templates based on real traffic traces (ENG-2460), integrate with perf-canary for automated regression alerts.
